title: kids rugby-field city s-Hertogenbosch Netherlands 725 pm 250827_0002 by klankbeeld
author: klankbeeld
sourceDescription: Training kids rugby (100m away). On the edge of the windy city, near the city centre, lies Zuiderpark. On a distance of 100m children play and train on the grounds of The Dukes Rugby. The trainers coach enthusiastically. A shuffling man walks by. He looks but says nothing. Traffic rushes down the busy street and parks in the underground car park.
